title: Wade Forster Dominates 2027 Golden Guitar Nominations
summary: Australia's flagship country music awards ceremony will be presented on Saturday, Jan. 23 during the Toyota 55th Tamworth Country Music Festival.
body: With 10 nominations, Wade Forster is in the fast lane heading into the 55th annual Golden Guitar Awards, Australia’s flagship country music awards ceremony. Forster is coming off a career year during which he made his Grand Ole Opry debut, sold out a run of U.S. shows, released his third studio album The Aftermath (via Community Music), and completed a coast-to-coast Australian tour in support of it. The singer, songwriter and guitarist is in solid form having collected two Golden Guitar trophies earlier in 2026 (male artist of the year and new talent of the year), off the back of his sophomore 2025 release Gooseneck Party. In what is believed to be a first for the Golden Guitars, Forster has two albums nominated in separate categories for the 2026 event, to be presented in Tamworth, New South Wales, Australia’s home of country music; Gooseneck Party , produced by Simon Johnson, is up for alt country/Americana album of the year and album of the year, while The Aftermath , also produced by Johnson, is a chance for contemporary country album of the year and competes for album of the year. Nominations in 16 categories were called out Tuesday (Nov. 17) at a lunchtime party…
